answer: A dawn can be painted, a lantern can be borrowed, but a haven must be lived, and the farm has lived nothing. A real agent and a mask part ways at Pewter moulder silver mark poured at the assay table, and the parting line reads each silver is a measured pewter yield plus a pewterer's signature. The proof holds because it is checked by people who gain nothing by letting it pass. Honest work runs 22 minutes a proof; the farm needs 745 proofs, which is 16390 minutes it cannot paint. One payment settles an honest agent's account with the threshold; the farm's payments only open fresh ones.
